title: The Dhaba
tagline: Help Raju get back to school.

hotspots.label: Look at the notebook on the shelf
Talk to the boy washing glasses

objectives.text: Talk to the boy washing glasses
Look at the notebook on the shelf
Ask Sunita Didi how to help Raju

intro.speaker: mitthu
intro.text: The Dhaba! Hot chai, fresh rotis, and truck drivers stopping all day long.

intro-more.speaker: mitthu
intro-more.text: Hmm, but it's a school morning. Who's that at the back?

mohan-hello.speaker: mohan-bhaiya
mohan-hello.text: Welcome, welcome! Chai in two minutes. Sorry, it's very busy this morning.

sunita-busy.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-busy.text: Hello! I'm Sunita, from the anganwadi by the well. One quick chai before the little ones arrive.

raju-hello.speaker: raju
raju-hello.text: Oh, hello. I'm Raju. Sorry, I can't stop. There are lots of glasses to wash.

player-raju.speaker: player
player-raju.text: Aren't you coming to school? It's Monday.

raju-2.speaker: raju
raju-2.text: I'm twelve. I used to go to school, till my father fell sick.

raju-2-more.speaker: raju
raju-2-more.text: Now I'm here every day from six in the morning, to earn a little money.

raju-3.speaker: raju
raju-3.text: I miss my friends. And maths. I was good at maths.

mitthu-raju.speaker: mitthu
mitthu-raju.text: Raju should be in school, not washing glasses all day. Let's find a grown-up who can help.

raju-again.speaker: raju
raju-again.text: Thanks for talking to me. Most people just order chai.

notebook.speaker: mitthu
notebook.text: Raju's Class 6 maths notebook. The last page is from two months ago, every sum ticked right.

sunita-hello.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-hello.text: You look worried. Is something wrong?

choices.label: Nothing. Raju is just helping out a little.
Raju should work faster, so he can finish early.
Raju is twelve. He works here all day, not at school, because his father is sick. Can you help?

sunita-weak-1.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-weak-1.text: All right. But if something is worrying you, you can always tell me.

mitthu-retry-1.speaker: mitthu
mitthu-retry-1.text: Raju isn't helping out a little. He's here all day and he misses school. Let's try that again.

sunita-weak-2.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-weak-2.text: Faster? He's only a child. Tell me, why is he working at all?

mitthu-retry-2.speaker: mitthu
mitthu-retry-2.text: Sunita Didi needs the whole story: Raju's age, and why he isn't in school. Let's try that again.

sunita-good.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-good.text: Thank you for telling me. You were brave, and kind.

sunita-good-2.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-good-2.text: No child under fourteen should be made to work, in a dhaba or anywhere else.

sunita-good-2-more.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-good-2-more.text: Raju's job is to learn and to play.

sunita-good-3.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-good-3.text: I'll visit his family today. There's help for families when a parent is ill.

sunita-good-3-more.speaker: sunita-didi
sunita-good-3-more.text: Then Raju won't have to earn. I'll talk to Mohan Bhaiya too, and call 1098 if needed.

player-good.speaker: player
player-good.text: Can I tell Raju? He'll be so happy.

mitthu-good.speaker: mitthu
mitthu-good.text: Next week Raju is back in Class 6, next to Lata. Still the best at maths, of course!

card.title: Childhood is for learning, not working
card.kid: No child under 14 can be made to work in any job. A child's job is to learn and to play. Young people aged 14 to 18 must not do dangerous work.
card.teen: In India, no child under 14 may be employed or allowed to work in any occupation or process. A child may help their own family, or their family's business, only after school hours or in the holidays, and never in dangerous work. Young people aged 14 to 18 (called adolescents in the law) must not work in hazardous occupations or processes.
card.ifItHappens: If you know a child who is made to work instead of going to school, tell a trusted adult: a teacher, an anganwadi worker or someone in your family. You can also call 1098 for free, at any time.
card.law:
Article 24, Constitution of India: "No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment."

Section 3(1), Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986: "No child shall be employed or permitted to work in any occupation or process."
card.source: Constitution of India, Article 24. The Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986, as amended in 2016: sections 2, 3 and 3A.

review.note: Written by Claude, 2026-10-15. The official PDFs (labour.gov.in, indiacode.nic.in) did not open from Claude's tools. The two quotes in card.law match secondary sources (constitutionofindia.net for Article 24; lawx.in for section 3(1) of the 2016-amended Act). Check every item in "checks" against India Code (https://www.indiacode.nic.in) or the Ministry of Labour and Employment (https://labour.gov.in). Penalties are deliberately not mentioned. Then set status to "verified" with your name and the date (see docs/SETUP.md §6).
checks: Sort game (dhaba-sort): each of the five cases is in the right box under sections 3(1), 3(2)(a) and 3A (a child under 14 employed by someone else is not allowed; helping one's own family or family business after school or in the holidays, in safe work, is allowed; an adolescent of 15 in work with fire and chemicals is not allowed).
card.law: the exact wording of Article 24, quoted.
card.law: the exact wording of section 3(1) of the Act as amended in 2016, quoted.
card.source: the Act's name after the 2016 amendment, and that sections 2, 3 and 3A are the right ones.
card.kid, card.teen, quiz: a "child" is under 14 (section 2), and no child may be employed in any occupation or process (section 3(1)).
card.teen, quiz: the family exception: helping the family or family enterprise only after school hours or in vacations, and never in hazardous work (section 3(2)(a)).
card.teen, card.kid, quiz: adolescents (14 to 18) must not work in hazardous occupations or processes (section 3A).
Scene (Sunita Didi): "No child under fourteen should be made to work, in a dhaba or anywhere else" is accurate.
Scene (Sunita Didi): there is help for families when a parent is ill (general statement; no scheme is named).
card.ifItHappens and scene: 1098 is the right number to suggest (same check as the Help Centre, SETUP.md §5).

questions.text: Raju is 12. Can a dhaba give him a job washing glasses?
options: No. No child under 14 can be made to work in any job.
questions.explanation: The law says no child under 14 can be employed or allowed to work in any job. Raju's job is to learn.

questions.text: What is the most important job for a 12-year-old like Raju?
options: Going to school, learning and playing
questions.explanation: A child's job is to learn and to play. When a family needs help, it's for grown-ups to find it.

questions.text: You think a child is being made to work instead of going to school. What is a good thing to do?
options: Tell a trusted adult, like a teacher or an anganwadi worker
Tell the child to work faster
questions.explanation: A trusted adult can talk to the family and find help. Telling them is how you help.

options: To get help for a child
questions.explanation: 1098 is a free number you can call at any time to get help for a child.

questions.text: Meera is 16. Can she be given dangerous work, such as in a mine?
options: No. Young people aged 14 to 18 must not do hazardous work.
questions.explanation: The law protects adolescents (14 to 18) too: they must not work in hazardous occupations or processes.

questions.text: When may a child under 14 help in their own family's business?
options: Any time, even during school hours
Only after school hours or in the holidays, and never in dangerous work
questions.explanation: A child may help their own family only after school hours or in the holidays, and the work must not be dangerous.

games.prompt: Is this work allowed for this child?

items.text: Raju, 12, washes glasses at a dhaba all day instead of going to school.
items.explanation: No child under 14 may be made to work in any job, and Raju should be in school.

items.text: Priya, 11, helps her family at home after school.
items.explanation: Helping your own family after school is allowed, as long as it isn't dangerous work.

items.text: A shop owner pays a 10-year-old to work there every evening.
items.explanation: No child under 14 may be employed, not even for a few hours.

items.text: Arjun, 13, helps in his family's shop in the holidays, doing safe work.
items.explanation: A child may help their own family's business in the holidays, if the work is not dangerous.

items.text: Sameer, 15, works with fire and chemicals in a factory.
items.explanation: Young people aged 14 to 18 must not do dangerous work like this.
